elliott: Confirmed H1 wave-1/wave-2 pivot hypothesis; retracement 0.382 to 0.786 and current price beyond the wave-2 anchor. Preferred count invalidates through that anchor; alternate wave-2 continuation stays unconfirmed and invalidates beyond origin. No retrospective relabelling.
smc: Last two confirmed H1 highs and lows must both move in the proposed direction.
poi: Prior completed 5m three-candle FVG of at least 5bp or last opposite candle preceding a 20-bar close break with directional body at least 60%. Full candle OB bounds; 24h expiry; hard close invalidation.
inducement: A nearer same-direction POI must have failed before intended-zone arrival; pre-touch confirmed 5m liquidity pivot must subsequently be swept and reclaimed in a candle beginning after touch.
mss: Within three bars after reclaim, a later directional body >=60%, close in outer quarter, fresh cross of pre-touch confirmed opposite 5m pivot by one tick.
profile: Previous full UTC day, exact traded-price quote turnover, 100 tick-aligned rows, 70% POC-neighbour expansion; intended zone must overlap its directional value edge within 0.25 H1 ATR14.
footprint: Five reconciled exact minute footprints; 0.05 ATR14(5m) tick-aligned rows; directional quote delta >=15% and three adjacent diagonal 3:1 imbalances, positive denominators, each numerator >=1% turnover.
entry: First fresh quote >=250ms after confirmation, spread <=10bp, inside frozen zone and <=0.25 5m ATR beyond close. T1 must be before prior POC.
ladder: Middle and far edge require separately later 5m flow/outer-quarter confirmation and a quote still inside one-row band, improved average and unchanged total budget. No skipped rungs; no adds after profit-taking; 60m add expiry.
portfolio_order: First causally complete opportunity; never reorder events using later spreads. A simultaneous busy campaign is logged as missed.
stop: Beyond far zone edge or rejection extreme by 0.10 H1 ATR14; tick-rounded away; never widened.
cost_disclosure: Frozen research assumptions, not the account's verified fee tier. Charge 10bp funding reserve per entry as a conservative model cost, not actual exchange funding. Quote-side hypothetical fills require displayed L1 size; no depth/queue/live execution claim.
outcome: Net-positive fully closed campaigns / all fully closed campaigns. Open, missed and censored campaigns excluded; no closed trades means null WR. Stop gaps use observed executable quote, not the stop price.
trade_population: All publicTrade volumes, including any block/RPI-flagged executions, are included consistently for candle reconciliation, profile and footprint. Regular L1 quote size is the hypothetical executable-size bound; RPI liquidity is not assumed accessible.
retention: Bounded live state; 32MiB SQLite maximum and 200000 ledger events. Outside eligible contexts retain candles, reconciled 5m bars and hashed minute receipts. Two UTC days of derived exact profile inputs; frozen profiles and decision evidence retained in ledger/capture. Full trade/quote detail around eligible contexts and throughout open paper campaigns. Source captures not automatically deleted. 128MB capacity reserve includes derived state/export overhead.
